origin.description: Each chunk is a small table with one character column.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Each chunk is a small table with one character column.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
out <- read_lines_chunked(I("a\nb\nc"), ListCallback$new(function(x, pos) paste(x, collapse = ",")), chunk_size = 2)
paste(unlist(out), collapse = ";")

translation.description: Each chunk is a small table with one character column.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Each chunk is a small table with one character column.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
out = read_lines_chunked(I("a\nb\nc"), ListCallback(lambda data, pos: ",".join(cell(v) for v in data.columns[0])), chunk_size=2)
return ";".join(out)
